images.description: A coordinated craft collection featuring a lake and countryside theme with watercolor-style illustrations. The set includes patterned cardstock sheets (sky blue, green plaid, cream), decorative elements (wooden circle, copper accents, small repeated shapes), illustrated panels with dock/pier, cottage, bicycle and nature scenes, a wooden ring, and various coordinating text boxes and embellishments in blue, green, brown, and cream tones.

A collection of handmade greeting cards featuring coastal and nature-themed designs in blue, green, and neutral tones. The assortment includes birthday, Father's Day, and thank you cards with watercolor-style illustrations of bicycles, beach scenes, lighthouses, and wooden docks. Cards are displayed in fanned arrangements showing coordinating striped and patterned papers.

descriptions.text: Loved making your summer-night invitations? The Sparkling Celebrations Paper Pumpkin Refill gives you all the consumable supplies you need to create even more of those charming, silver-foiled cards from the original kit. Ideal for larger gatherings or when you simply want extras on hand. DETAILS - Makes 9 cards: 3 each of 3 designs - Colors: Black, Blackberry Bliss, Coastal Cabana, Daffodil Delight, Hydrangea Hue, Melon Mambo, Misty Moonlight, Night of Navy, Pumpkin Pie - Includes silver foil Refill includes one of each item listed below. - 9 printed card bases: 3 each of 3 designs - Folded card size: 5-1/2" x 4-1/4" (14 x 10.8 cm) - 9 printed envelopes - Precut pieces - Silver gem embellishments - Adhesive You must be a current Paper Pumpkin subscriber to purchase this item. To become a subscriber, visit www.stampinup.com/global/paperpumpkin.

images.description: A comprehensive paper crafting collection featuring coordinated cardstock and specialty papers with sunset, lantern, and fireworks themes in purple, orange, yellow, and blue tones. The set includes two pads of gradient cardstock (one with hanging lanterns, one solid gradient), printed design sheets with lanterns and fireworks motifs, decorative elements sheet, blank cardstock, a metal circle frame, and small crystal embellishments.

A collection of greeting card products featuring various designs with evening and celebration themes. The set includes window-style cards with lantern scenes, fireworks celebration cards with dimensional elements, invitation cards with string light designs, and coordinating blank cardstock in blue, teal, and gold gradients. Multiple cards are layered to show variety within the product line.

descriptions.text: If you used up every piece of the Bikes & Blooms Paper Pumpkin Kit, the Refill is here to keep the magic going. You’ll get cards and envelopes with vintage-style bikes, plant-filled baskets, and fluttering butterflies in soft pastels so you can keep creating feel-good cards that look like a gentle breeze on paper. DETAILS - Makes 9 cards: 3 each of 3 designs - Colors: Basic Black, Calypso Coral, Crushed Curry, Lost Lagoon, Old Olive, Pecan Pie, silver - Includes silver foil Refill includes one of each item listed below. - 9 printed card bases: 3 each of 3 designs - Folded card size: 5-1/2" x 4-1/4" (14 x 10.8 cm) - 9 printed envelopes - Precut paper pieces - Small and large silver butterflies - Linen thread - Stampin’ Dimensionals - Mini Glue Dots - Adhesive
